newsitem.title: USA: D&P reaffirms Telephone/Data Systems rating.
newsitem.headline: D&P reaffirms Telephone/Data Systems rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said on Monday it has reaffirmed a triple-B medium-term note rating of Telephone and Data Systems Inc after the company's announcement of a three million common share buyback plan.
Telephone and Data has initiated a share buyback program to strengthen its share price, D&P said in a statement.
Telephone and Data owns and operates cellular, telephone, paging and PCS businesses.

The program, if completed, is expected to cost between $110-150 million. Although the program will be financed with short-term debt initially, D&P said it expects Telephone and Data to continue to capitalize its businesses in a conservative manner.

The ratings recognize the improving financial outlook of the company's cellular subsidiary and the heightened business risk and capital requirements resulting from its entry into the personal communications services (PCS) business, D&P said.

While the cellular and telephone businesses are expected to contribute healthy gains in cash flow, negative EBITDA generated from PCS in the initial years of operation will constrain improvement in quantitative performance, D&P said.
